# Rohit Gautam - Full Stack Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio and engineering blog of Rohit Gautam, a full-stack software engineer specializing in React, Node.js, Shopify, and AI-powered applications.

## About

- [Homepage](https://rohitgautam.site/): Overview of skills, featured projects, tech stack, career timeline, and contact information.
- [About](https://rohitgautam.site/about): Detailed background, engineering philosophy, and professional summary.
- [Experience](https://rohitgautam.site/experience): Full career history, roles, and responsibilities.
- [Resume](https://rohitgautam.site/resume): Downloadable résumé and professional credentials.

## Projects

- [All Projects](https://rohitgautam.site/projects): Showcase of full-stack products, commerce platforms, and AI-powered workflows.
- [Music Streaming Platform](https://rohitgautam.site/projects/music-streaming-platform): Subscription-based music streaming application with real-time features.
- [Multi-Vendor Marketplace](https://rohitgautam.site/projects/multi-vendor-marketplace): Scalable e-commerce marketplace with vendor management.
- [AI Consultation Platform](https://rohitgautam.site/projects/ai-consultation-platform): AI-powered consultation and workflow automation platform.
- [Shopify Storefront Engineering](https://rohitgautam.site/projects/shopify-storefront-engineering): Custom Shopify theme development and performance optimization.
- [Portfolio Website](https://rohitgautam.site/projects/portfolio-website): This portfolio site built with Astro, React, and Cloudflare.

## Blog

- [Engineering Blog](https://rohitgautam.site/blog): Technical articles on web performance, React patterns, Node.js architecture, and Shopify development.
